name: app-flow-preview-summary-achievements-profile-closing-tagline
title: Flow cycling app: route preview, ride summary, achievements and profile screens ending in a bold closing tagline
whatItIs: A dark closing spread: a route-preview map, a ride-summary score card (85, distance, pace), a gamified 'Başarılar' (Achievements) screen with badges and level progress, a profile with stats and settings list, each captioned with rationale, then a bold black slide with a white organic blob and 'Dikkatin Yolda, Destek Flow'da.' (Your focus on the road, support from Flow).
whatItMeans: Motivating and complete; gamified badges close the loop from tracking to encouragement before the sign-off.
techniques: Close a fitness flow with badges and level progress.
End a case study with a short, punchy brand line.
Reuse the organic blob shape from the cover as a closing bookend.

vocabulary.definition: Using game mechanics like badges and levels to motivate.
A visual element repeated at the start and end for unity.
